Declared failure/recovery outcomes inherit the edge consumer context for policy separation; structural-exclusion repair outcomes inherit the excluded producer context. They cannot become authority inputs. This is not a new recovery executor or a claim that untyped paths are bounded.
Preserve legitimate release-to-compatibility observation and reporting flows; existing typed bounded recovery conformance remains unchanged.
Apply the same guard from authored preflight; return shape and valid model remain unchanged. No provider behavior or optional adopter policy change.
